messages:
Ara: Heads up — Acme wants to close via AWS Marketplace but procurement is blocking on invoice + PO mapping. They want a commit + usage cap. Any quick blockers?
Devon: Quick SE note: POC ran on 4xA10G, stable at ~85ms p95 for their payload. They want a tiered commit (seats + usage) and an overage cap per month.
Sam: Finance: Marketplace public invoices won't include customer PO on line items for 3-way match. That usually kills their AP flow. :grimacing:
Katie: Procurement (Acme): Correct — our AP requires PO on each invoice line item or automated 3-way match fails. We can only accept net30 + PO.
billing-bot: marketplace-invoice-fyi: public marketplace invoices do not surface per-line customer PO; private offers can surface PO in invoice metadata depending on flow. See https://go.aws/marketplace/invoice
Ara: So looks like public marketplace won't work. Can we do a private offer + commit where AWS routes invoices but includes PO metadata?
Devon: Yes, private offer + commit is the usual path. Two things: (1) we need to create a pricing file with commit tiers and overage ceilings, (2) map seats to a marketplace SKU so procurement can PO.
Sam: Deal desk perspective: If we go private offer, revenue ops must confirm how commit credits are applied (monthly vs advance). Also legal needs to sign private offer terms. This can affect rev recognition.
ops-legal: Legal: we'll need an addendum clarifying seller-of-record, tax handling, and dispute routing when marketplace is involved. Expect 3 business days for review unless we escalate.
Katie: Timeline is tight — Acme needs PO issued by next Tuesday to hit their quarter close. Any expedited path?
Devon: Two options: 
• Short-term: Redwood issues invoice (seller-of-record) directly under our contract — allows PO on invoice line items and immediate closure, but requires finance & legal ok for seller-of-record.
• Proper: Private Offer via AWS MP with PO metadata and commit — safer for marketplace rules but takes ~3 business days + AWS processing.
Sam: Finance preference: seller-of-record route only if we can accept the tax and AR risk. Otherwise private offer. We need revenue ops and tax sign-off.
Ara: @Sam I'll loop in revenue-ops now. @ops-legal can you flag this for expedited review? I'll mark dealdesk as urgent.
ops-legal: Flagged — will try to turn addendum draft in 48 hours if legal bandwidth allows.
Devon: I'll start drafting the rate card and SKU mapping. Quick question for procurement: do you need PO visible at invoice header or per-line?
Katie: Per-line PO is required for our 3-way match. Header-only won't cut it.
Devon: Noted. For private offer, we'll include PO in the line-item metadata payload as: `{"customer_po": "PO-12345"}` — confirm that's acceptable.
billing-bot: private-offer-note: AWS MP supports passing customer PO in the private offer invoice metadata but final visibility depends on buyer AP system. Recommend a test invoice.
Sam: Finance: if we do seller-of-record, we'll need to approve net30 and absorb AR; otherwise, private offer + commit is preferred. I'll start a quick risk assessment.
Ara: OK — plan: (1) Devon drafts rate card & SKU mapping (ETA EOD), (2) Ops-legal drafts addendum (48h target), (3) Ara opens urgent deal-desk + revenue-ops loop, (4) Katie to confirm exact PO format and AP test window. If all green, proceed private offer.
Katie: I can run an AP test if you send a sample invoice with PO metadata. Need that by EOD tomorrow.
Devon: Will send sample invoice payload and rate card draft by EOD.
Ara: Deal desk ticket created (#4821) and marked urgent. I'll update once revenue-ops weighs in. Thanks everyone. :pray:
